title: ABUNDANT PROVISION
GOD SATISFIES
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: calm river at sunset golden light

scenes.a: As you calculate tonight's deficit and wonder where the next meal comes from, listen to God.
Father, we bring every empty pantry and unpaid bill before Your holy throne right now.
We trust in Your unfailing promise spoken in Your holy word for our daily sustenance.
Your word declares, I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Lord, grant us this daily bread and remove the paralyzing grip of scarcity from our minds.
We rest in Your faithfulness today, knowing You provide for all our needs in Christ.
